description: A chained Memo (row 7, 9000 ASCII characters) edited in four steps: replaced by 9000 different characters (same size); grown to 13000; shrunk to 100; set to Null. Asks how a chain is rewritten, extended, truncated and released. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
